label: IGH / MAFB

sections.text: IGH is the immunoglobulin heavy-chain locus, with potent B-lineage regulatory elements.
MAFB encodes a bZIP transcription factor involved in lineage differentiation.
t(14;20) places MAFB under IGH regulatory control, increasing a lineage-altering transcriptional program. It is a recurrent primary IGH translocation in plasma cell myeloma.
